Class PostgresFactory

java.lang.Object
ry.ms.AbsFactory
ry.ms.PostgresFactory
public class PostgresFactory extends AbsFactory
A concrete factory that creates instances of DAOs. This implementation of AbsFactory is responsible for instantiating the specific DAO implementations for the application.
